Fused_Cephalothorax_Chassis.description: A highly robust, completely fused head and thorax (prosoma) serving as an impenetrable armored anchor point for eight violently fast, hydraulic limbs.

Elongated_Segmented_Carapace.description: A heavily segmented, elongated, extraordinarily tough chitinous frame featuring massive tergite plates overlapping the abdomen. It sacrifices the vertical agility of a spider for the grinding, unstoppable terrestrial advance of a desert scorpion.

Microscopic_Parasitic_Core.description: An unbelievably compact, practically microscopic chassis composed of a single, undifferentiated rounded mass (idiosoma). Optimized purely for invisibility, parasitism, and horrific infiltration of host cardiovascular systems.

Goliath_Tarantula_Bulk.description: A gargantuan, extraordinarily heavy spider frame capable of achieving a leg span exceeding a foot. Lacking the tensile agility required for webs, it operates entirely as a brutal terrestrial ambush engine capable of physically wrestling small mammals.

Violently_Compressed_Frame.description: A severely dorsoventrally flattened chassis resembling a tailless whip scorpion. Evolved exclusively to slip invisibly beneath peeling bark and through impossibly narrow rock fissures while remaining perfectly flush against the surface.

Orb_Weaver_Suspension_Core.description: An incredibly delicate, fragile frame featuring an enormous, bulbous abdomen functioning as a massive silk reservoir. Built entirely to hang perfectly inverted in the absolute center of a high-tension geometric web.

Heavily_Calcified_Opiliones_Husk.description: A tiny, singular, fused pill-like body held aloft on absurdly long, unarmored stilts. The actual core body itself is highly calcified and exceedingly difficult to crush, resembling a heavily armored biological pebble.

Subterranean_Trapdoor_Bulk.description: A very thick, heavily reinforced chassis possessing massive, shovel-like cheliceral structures directly integrated into the prosoma frame. Functionally acts as a heavily armored excavator capable of hollowing out immensely deep, vertical silken bunkers.

Aquatic_Diving_Bell_Core.description: A deeply modified abdomen shaped to maximize exterior surface tension, designed to perfectly trap and hold a massive silvery bubble of atmospheric oxygen tightly against the spiracles while hunting entirely underwater.

Pseudo_Scorpion_Pincer_Frame.description: A bizarre, tailless frame consisting entirely of a heavily armored prosoma and oversized, venomous pincers (pedipalps). Specialized for extreme close-quarters grappling in total darkness.
